+ struct RecordBatchIterator {
+     batches: Vec&lt;RecordBatch&gt;,
+     schema: Arc&lt;Schema&gt;,
+     current: usize,
+ }
+ 
+ impl RecordBatchIterator {
+     fn new(batches: Vec&lt;RecordBatch&gt;, schema: Arc&lt;Schema&gt;) -&gt; Self {
+         Self {
+             batches,
+             schema,
+             current: 0,
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ impl RecordBatchReader for RecordBatchIterator {
+     fn schema(&amp;self) -&gt; Arc&lt;Schema&gt; {
+         self.schema.clone()
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ impl Iterator for RecordBatchIterator {
+     type Item = Result&lt;RecordBatch, arrow::error::ArrowError&gt;;
+ 
+     fn next(&amp;mut self) -&gt; Option&lt;Self::Item&gt; {
+         if self.current &lt; self.batches.len() {
+             let batch = self.batches[self.current].clone();
+             self.current += 1;
+             Some(Ok(batch))
+         } else {
+             None
+         }
+     }
+ }

+ // Simple function to tokenize text by whitespace and generate numeric IDs
+ fn simple_tokenize(text: &amp;str) -&gt; Vec&lt;u32&gt; {
+     let mut vocab = std::collections::HashMap::new();
+     let mut next_id = 0;
+     
+     text.split_whitespace()
+         .map(|token| {
+             if !vocab.contains_key(token) {
+                 vocab.insert(token, next_id);
+                 next_id += 1;
+             }
+             *vocab.get(token).unwrap()
+         })
+         .collect()
+ }
